content: Official NIP-90 is draft, optional, and currently marked unrecommended in favor of use-case-specific microstandards. It maps signed request kinds 5000-5999 to result kinds plus 1000 and uses kind 7000 feedback statuses payment-required, processing, error, success, and partial. Payment-required plus an amount tag and optional bolt11 is the normative stop gate; requests/results reference each other with e, p, and request tags.
